blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Spatial intelligence requires agents to actively acquire visual evidence and integrate observations into a coherent representation of the three-dimensional world. Yet spatial question answering offers limited evidence of whether models can construct accurate metric maps through autonomous exploration. We introduce SpatialScout, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language model (VLM) agents on active object-level 3D mapping. SpatialScout comprises 80 diverse indoor scenes containing 3,140 target objects. Given an object inventory, RGB observations, camera calibration, and camera poses, agents control a camera to explore each scene and estimate object centers in a shared coordinate frame. The task requires coordinating viewpoint selection, cross-view association, geometric estimation, and map revision under bounded interaction budgets. Evaluation jointly measures localization accuracy and target coverage through object-scale overlap scores that penalize missing predictions. Experiments with frontier VLMs reveal substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated model, Claude Opus 5.5, achieves a mean overlap score of 41.71%, with 47.23% of targets exceeding an intersection-over-union (IoU) threshold of 0.5 and only 3.25% exceeding 0.9. These results reveal a substantial gap between recovering coarse object layouts and constructing complete, precise metric maps. SpatialScout provides a quantitative testbed for developing agents that build reliable 3D spatial representations through active perception. Code is available at https://github.com/JesseZZZZZ/SpatialScout.

blocks.en:
Spatial intelligence is fundamental to embodied agents’ ability to understand and act in 3D environments [ 34 , 16 ] .
It requires agents to actively observe their surroundings to resolve occlusion and perspective ambiguities, infer object locations and spatial relationships, and integrate evidence across views into a consistent 3D representation [ 20 , 21 ] .
Evaluating this entire process is central to assessing the spatial capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs).
Existing spatial intelligence benchmarks widely adopt image- and video-based question answering (QA) to assess counting, direction, distance, and spatial relations [ 55 , 50 ] .
Although these evaluations have revealed substantial model limitations, answer accuracy imposes only limited constraints on spatial understanding.
Finite answer choices allow models to arrive at correct answers through guessing or elimination; language priors and biases in answer distributions may also enable correct responses based on non-spatial cues [ 15 , 1 ] .
More importantly, spatial QA does not fully capture real-world demands: agents must autonomously gather evidence, update spatial representations, and use them to guide subsequent actions [ 34 , 62 ] .
Evaluating frontier VLMs therefore requires end-to-end assessment of this multi-step process, beyond answer accuracy alone.
blocks.zh:
空间情报是体现代理人在三维环境中理解和行动的能力的基础[34、16]。
它要求代理人积极观察其周围环境,以解决隐蔽性和视角模糊性,推断出物体位置和空间关系,并将各种观点的证据纳入一致的立体表示[20,21].
评价整个过程对于评估视觉语言模型的空间能力至关重要。
现有的空间情报基准广泛采用以图像和视频为基础的问答(QA),以评估计数、方向、距离和空间关系[55、50]。
虽然这些评价揭示出重大的模型局限性,但答案准确性仅对空间理解造成有限的限制.
有限的答案选择允许模型通过猜想或消除得出正确的答案;答案分配中的语言前科和偏差也可能使得基于非空间提示的正确答案 [15, 1].
更重要的是,空间QA不能完全捕捉到现实世界的要求:代理商必须自主地收集证据,更新空间表示,并用它们来指导后续行动[34,62].
因此,评估前沿甚高频需要对这一多步骤进程进行端到端评估,而不只是答案准确性。

blocks.en:
Bridging this gap requires evaluating autonomous information acquisition and spatial representation construction within a single task, forming a closed loop of observation, reasoning, and decision-making.
Recent benchmarks such as ESI-Bench [ 21 ] and S 3 -Bench [ 51 ] introduce active interaction into spatial QA, while Theory of Space [ 62 ] examines the construction of discrete cognitive maps.
Our key advance is to make the construction of object maps in continuous 3D space through active interaction a direct evaluation objective for spatial intelligence.
Models must autonomously acquire visual evidence and recover the 3D positions of a target set in a common coordinate frame.
This task couples active perception, cross-view association, geometric estimation, and scene modeling: the current spatial estimate determines what to observe next, while the selected viewpoint shapes the evidence available thereafter.
Through spatial construction beyond QA, feedback-driven active exploration, and end-to-end task evaluation, we examine whether VLMs can transform local observations into accurate and complete metric spatial representations.
blocks.zh:
缩小这一差距需要在一个单一任务范围内评估自主的信息获取和空间代表结构,形成一个闭合的观察、推理和决策循环。
最近的基准如ESI-Bench [21]和S 3-Bench [51]将活性互动引入了空间QA,而"空间理论"[62]则研究了离散认知图的构建.
我们的关键进步是通过积极的交互作用,使连续3D空间的物体地图的构建成为空间智能的直接评价目标.
模型必须自主获取视觉证据并取回一个共同坐标框中设定的目标的3D位置.
这个任务夫妇活动感知,交叉视图关联,几何估计,以及场景模型化:当前的空间估计决定了接下来的观测内容,而所选择的视角则塑造了之后可用的证据.
通过超越QA的空间构造,反馈驱动活性探索,以及端到端任务评价,我们审视VLM能否将局部观测转化为准确而完整的度量空间表示.

blocks.en:
To this end, we introduce SpatialScout , a benchmark for evaluating the spatial intelligence of vision-language agents through active object-level 3D mapping.
Starting from an initial observation and a target inventory, an agent autonomously explores the scene and progressively constructs a 3D map of target object centers in a common coordinate frame.
The benchmark has three core features:
\scriptsize1⃝ Explicit spatial construction. Models must output a set of 3D object positions, enabling quantitative evaluation of spatial representation quality through localization accuracy and target coverage.
\scriptsize2⃝ Closed-loop active exploration. Models select subsequent viewpoints based on existing observations and the current map, then update position estimates using new evidence, forming a feedback loop between the active acquisition of perceptual evidence and spatial understanding.
\scriptsize3⃝ Long-horizon end-to-end capability evaluation. Models coordinate observation planning, object recognition, cross-view association, geometric estimation, and map updates across multiple interaction steps, with overall performance measured by final map quality.
This sustained coordination goes beyond QA tasks with short reasoning chains and better reflects real-world spatial understanding.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们引入了SpaceScout,这是通过主动的物体级3D映射来评价视觉语言剂的空间智能的基准.
从初步观察和目标盘点开始,一个代理人自主地探索场景,并逐步在共同的坐标框中构建目标对象中心的3D地图.
该基准有三个核心特征:
=============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================== 模型必须输出出一组3D对象位置,能够通过本地化精度和目标覆盖对空间代表质量进行定量评价.
\scription2\%% 闭路活动探索. 模型根据现有的观测结果和目前的地圖来选择后续的观点,再用新的证据来更新位置估计,在主动获取知觉证据和空间理解之间形成反馈回路.
\scription3}长视线端到端能力评价. 模型协调观测规划,对象识别,交叉视图关联,几何估计,以及跨多互动步骤的地图更新,整体性能由最终地图质量来测量.
这种持续的协调超越了质量保证任务,有短的推理链,更好地反映了现实世界的空间理解.

blocks.en:
SpatialScout comprises 80 indoor scenes and 3,140 target objects, with 30–40 targets per scene, spanning diverse spatial layouts, object scales, and repeated category instances.
The benchmark provides a unified set of camera-control and geometric assistance tools, along with camera intrinsics and poses, and requires models to infer object centers from autonomously acquired visual evidence.
Evaluation jointly measures geometric estimation error, localization accuracy relative to object scale, and target coverage.
We also record map updates under a limited interaction budget to analyze how object-level spatial representations emerge as exploration proceeds.
blocks.zh:
SpaceScout由80个室内场景和3,140个目标物体组成,每个场景有30-40个目标,跨越了不同的空间布局,物体尺度和重复的类别实例.
该基准提供了一套统一的相机控制和几何辅助工具,以及相机内在和外观,并要求模型从自主获取的视觉证据中推断出物体中心.
评价联合测量几何估计误差,相对于对象尺度的定位精度,以及目标覆盖.
我们还根据有限的互动预算记录地图更新情况,以分析随着勘探的进行,物体层面的空间表现如何出现。

blocks.en:
We evaluate frontier VLMs, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5.
The results show that models can recover parts of object layouts through autonomous exploration, but comprehensive coverage and precise localization remain challenging.
Models differ substantially in target omissions and center localization accuracy, while the proportion of targets meeting stringent scale-relative accuracy criteria remains low.
These findings indicate that recognizing objects or making coarse spatial judgments does not necessarily translate into constructing reliable metric maps.
By exposing these limitations through measurable localization and coverage metrics, SpatialScout provides a unified benchmark for studying how models construct and understand the 3D world through autonomous interaction.
blocks.zh:
我们评估前沿甚高频,包括GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5。
结果显示,模型可以通过自主探索来恢复部分物体布局,但全面的覆盖和精确的本地化仍然具有挑战性.
模型在目标省略和中心本地化准确度方面差别很大,而符合严格的比例尺相对准确性标准的目标比例仍然很低.
这些调查结果表明,识别物体或作出粗糙的空间判断并不一定会转化为构建可靠的测量图.
通过可测量的本地化和覆盖度衡量标准,SpaceScout为研究模型如何通过自主互动构建和理解3D世界提供了一个统一的基准.

blocks.en:
SpatialScout evaluates active object-center mapping by VLM agents.
Given an object inventory and calibrated camera poses, an agent selects RGB views, associates objects across observations, and maintains a three-dimensional map of their centers.
The benchmark combines a fixed scene catalog, a shared interaction interface, and object-level evaluation to measure the accuracy and completeness of the resulting map (Fig. 3 ).

blocks.en: 5 Discussions

blocks.en: We present the models’ tool-calling behaviors in Fig. 5 and Fig. 6 . These visualizations reveal differences in behaviors that provide insight into their ability to understand 3D space.
blocks.zh: 我们用图5和图6介绍模型的工具召唤行为。 这些可视化揭示出行为差异,为了解3D空间的能力提供洞察.

blocks.en: First, Claude-Opus-5.5 makes the largest number of tool calls. We cap each trajectory at 100 tool-calling turns, and a single turn may include multiple tool calls. Its extensive tool use appears to benefit its performance on SpatialScout by allowing it to gather and integrate more information about the scene.
blocks.zh: 首先,克洛德-奥普斯-5.5的调用量是最大的. 我们把每个轨迹封在100个工具调用转盘上,一个转盘可能包括多个工具调用. 其广泛使用的工具似乎有利于其在SpaceScout上的性能,因为它能够收集和综合更多有关现场的信息。

blocks.en: Second, GPT-6 Astra and Claude-Opus-5.5 maintain relatively balanced use of observation, camera movement, and mapping. By contrast, DS-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Max tend to observe less as the interaction progresses. This pattern may indicate difficulty maintaining and updating a reliable spatial representation: without observing consistently, a model must rely on earlier views, which may not contain sufficient information about newly encountered objects.
blocks.zh: 第二,GPT-6 Astra和Claude-Opus-5.5保持相对平衡地使用观测,相机移动和绘图. 相形之下,DS-V4.1-Flash和Qune3.8-Max往往随着相互作用的进展而较少观察到. 这种模式可能表明难以保持和更新可靠的空间代表性:如果不连贯一致地观测,模型必须依赖早期的观点,而早期的观点可能并不包含关于新发现物体的充分信息。

blocks.en:
Third, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Max spend many turns moving the camera but relatively few observing and mapping. This suggests that they have greater difficulty selecting informative viewpoints and converting visual observations into a coherent map. Such behavior adds interaction overhead, while uninformative views also consume context because images require substantial context length.
Taken together, these behavioral differences suggest that SpatialScout distinguishes models not only by their final localization accuracy, but also by how effectively they perceive, explore, and represent the 3D scene.
blocks.zh:
第三,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和Qune3.8-Max花费了许多转弯来移动相机,但观测和绘图相对较少. 这表明他们更难选择信息性的观点,将视觉观察转化为连贯的地图. 这种行为会增加交互性间接费用,而非信息性观点也会消耗上下文,因为图像需要大量的上下文长度.
综合起来,这些行为差异表明"SpaceScout"不仅用其最终本地化的精度来区分模型,而且用其感知,探索,并代表了3D场景的效率.

blocks.en: We analyze 40 trajectories from GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and Qwen3.8-Max on the same ten selected tasks, all using xhigh reasoning effort. We present the results in Table 4 . For this case study, reconstruction success requires at least 90% object coverage and a mean center error of at most 0.2 m over matched submitted objects. Six trajectories meet both criteria. All six exhibit extensive multi-view geometric grounding, incremental submission that expands coverage, and subsequent refinement of submitted positions. Among the 34 unsuccessful trajectories, incomplete coverage is the most common failure pattern, appearing in 26 cases. In 21 cases, at least one submitted position remains substantially inaccurate despite a low triangulation residual, suggesting incorrect visual correspondences or object-center selection that geometric consistency alone cannot resolve. Thirteen cases retain inaccurate positions associated with geometric inconsistency warnings, while another overlapping set of 13 cases terminates with insufficient coverage despite having at least ten response rounds remaining. Six cases submit a substantial fraction of positions without recorded tool-based triangulation, five involve extensive observation but limited localization progress, and three end with revisions to existing estimates without recovering missing objects. These patterns suggest that effective mapping depends on converting observations into reliable object correspondences, and checking uncertain estimates before the final termination.
blocks.zh: 我们分析来自GPT-6 Astra,克洛德·奥普斯·5.5,DeepSeek V4.1 Flash,和Qune3.8-Max的40个轨迹,它们都使用x高推理努力. 我们在表4中介绍了结果。 就本案例研究而言,重建成功需要至少90%的对象覆盖,平均中心误差最多0.2米,高于所提交的对象。 六道行相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相. 所有六个项目都展现出广泛的多视图几何定位、扩大覆盖面的递增提交以及随后对所提交的立场的改进。 在34个不成功的轨道中,不完全的覆盖是最常见的故障模式,出现在26个案例中. 在21个案例中,至少一个提交的位置仍然非常不准确,尽管三角残留不多,这表明不正确的视觉通信或对象中心选择,仅是几何一致性无法解决。 13个案件保留了与几何不一致警告有关的不准确立场,而另一组重叠的13个案件虽然至少还有10个答复回合,但覆盖面不够。 6起案件提交了大量未记录的基于工具的三角定位,5起涉及广泛观察,但本地化进展有限,有3起最后是修订现有估计数而未找回缺失物体。 这些模式表明,有效的映射取决于将观测转化为可靠的对象对应,并在最终终止前检查不确定的估计.

blocks.en: We use Codex powered by GPT-6 Astra to analyze both models’ trajectories across 80 shared tasks, as summarized in Table 5 . We select GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-flash because they make similar numbers of tool calls but achieve substantially different localization performance. GPT-6 Astra captures fewer images yet provides triangulation support for more submitted objects, with fewer geometric warnings. The triangulation tool requires fine-grained spatial perception to identify corresponding image points across views; DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash’s inconsistent measurements suggest difficulty meeting this requirement, despite capturing more images. These findings suggest that more effective geometric tool use contributes to GPT-6 Astra’s stronger localization performance.
blocks.zh: 我们用GPT-6 Astra 提供的代码分析两种模型的轨迹, 我们选择了GPT-6 Astra和DeepSeek-V4.1-flash,因为他们制作的工具调用次数相近,但实现的本地化性能却大相径庭. GPT-6 Astra捕捉到的图像较少,却为更多的提交对象提供三角化支持,几何警告较少. 三角测量工具需要精细的空间感知,才能辨别出不同观点中相应的图像点; DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的不一致的测量表明,尽管捕捉到更多的图像,但仍然难以满足这一要求. 这些调查结果表明,更有效的几何工具的使用有助于GPT-6 Astra更强大的本地化性能.

blocks.en: Figure 7 plots the mean IoU across all targets against the average inference cost (in USD, on a logarithmic scale), together with the Pareto frontier. Claude Opus 5.5 achieves the highest IoU, but also incurs the highest cost (28.85 USD per task), consistent with findings from other long-horizon agentic benchmarks [ 25 , 63 ] . Overall, the evaluated open-source models offer limited advantages in the accuracy–cost trade-off. Among them, only DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash costs less than GPT-6 Sol; Qwen3.8-Max and Kimi-K3 are both more expensive and achieve lower scores on all IoU metrics (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 图7根据平均推算成本(以美元为单位,对数规模)以及Pareto边界,列出了所有指标的平均IoU。 Claude Opus 5.5实现了最高的IoU, 但也付出了最高的成本(每次任务28.85美元),这与其他远视剂基准的结论一致[25,63]. 总的来说,经过评估的开源模型在准确性-成本权衡方面提供的优势有限。 其中,只有DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的成本低于GPT-6 Sol;Qune3.8-Max和Kimi-K3两者都比较昂贵,并且在所有IoU度量衡上都取得了较低的分数(表3).

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en:
IR3D-Bench evaluates scene understanding by reconstructing a scene from a supplied image [ 32 ] .
BlenderGym studies code-based graphics editing, including how generation, verification, and their compute allocation affect performance [ 17 ] .
BlenderAlchemy combines edit generation with visual evaluation [ 22 ] , while VIGA and BlenderBench examine interleaved execution, inspection, memory, and exploratory editing [ 60 ] .
SceneActBench evaluates executable multi-object outputs across several tasks; its reconstruction task builds furniture meshes in an initially empty scene from supplied calibrated views [ 64 ] .
These works establish construction and editing as meaningful tests of visual understanding.
Our setting emphasizes acquisition of new evidence from a hidden target environment and inspection and revision of an explicit object-center map.

blocks.en:
Selecting informative observations has a substantial history in three-dimensional perception.
SCONE predicts surface coverage gain [ 18 ] , and MACARONS couples RGB-based mapping with online coverage anticipation [ 19 ] .
GenNBV learns a generalizable view-selection policy [ 6 ] .
NARUTO, ActiveSplat, and ActiveGAMER integrate exploration with neural scene mapping [ 12 , 29 , 5 ] ; FisherRF uses information-based view selection for radiance fields [ 24 ] .
More directly, AIR-Embodied uses multimodal reasoning to plan reconstruction actions [ 40 ] .
AREA3D combines geometric perception and vision-language guidance, and introduces an evaluation covering object- and scene-level active reconstruction [ 54 ] .
SightCAD connects feasible view selection to executable CAD generation for scene-embedded objects [ 4 ] .
These systems provide important planning and reconstruction references.
Our benchmark compares general-purpose agents under shared tools and observation and model-call budgets, recording how their evidence acquisition and map updates interact.

blocks.en: Long-horizon agentic tasks require sustained reasoning and repeated tool use, often over multiple interaction rounds, and remain a major challenge for deploying LLM-based systems in real-world settings. AgentBench and GAIA evaluate interactive decision-making and general-purpose tool use [ 33 , 36 ] . WebShop and WebArena focus on web interaction, while VisualWebArena and OSWorld extend evaluation to visually grounded web and desktop environments [ 58 , 65 , 27 , 53 ] . The τ \tau -bench and DySQL-Bench examine tool use in settings with evolving user interactions [ 59 , 44 ] . SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench, NL2Repo, and RepoZero assess repository repair, command-line problem solving, and repository generation using executable checks [ 25 , 35 , 10 , 63 ] . AgenticRAGTracer complements these benchmarks with hop-level diagnosis of agentic retrieval processes [ 61 ] . SpatialScout is one of the benchmarks evaluating the spatial understanding and long-horizon capability of VLM agents.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced SpatialScout, a benchmark for evaluating the spatial intelligence of VLM agents through active object-level 3D mapping. By requiring agents to autonomously select viewpoints, integrate visual evidence, and estimate object positions in a shared coordinate frame, SpatialScout evaluates the complete process of constructing metric spatial representations. Our experiments reveal that frontier VLMs can recover partial scene layouts but still struggle to achieve both comprehensive coverage and precise localization. Even the strongest evaluated model attains a mean IoU of 41.71%, with only 3.25% of targets exceeding an IoU of 0.9. These findings highlight the difficulty of translating visual observations into reliable geometric estimates through sustained interaction. SpatialScout provides a testbed for advancing active perception, cross-view reasoning, and persistent spatial memory, supporting the development of agents capable of building accurate and complete representations of 3D environments.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了SpaceScout,这是通过主动的物体级3D绘图来评价VLM剂的空间智能的基准. SpaceScout通过要求代理商自主选择观点,整合视觉证据,并估算物体位置于共享坐标框架,评价构建度量空间表示的完整过程. 我们的实验表明,边疆甚高频可以恢复部分场景布局,但仍在努力实现全面覆盖和精确本地化。 即使最强的评价模型也达到平均IoU为41.71%,只有3.25%的目标超过了0.9的IoU. 这些调查结果突出了通过持续互动将视觉观测转化为可靠的几何估计的难度. 空间 Scout为推进活性感知,交叉视角推理,以及持续空间内存提供了测试台,支持能够建立准确而完整地表达3D环境的物剂的发展.

blocks.en: B.2 Scoring and Trace Replay

blocks.en:
For a scene with N N targets and M M accepted submissions, the position evaluator uses groupwise minimum-total-Euclidean-distance assignment.
Mean, median, RMSE, and mean IoU use that assignment.
Before assignment, predictions are ordered lexicographically by task-frame coordinates and targets by task-frame center and world-box side lengths, with identifiers breaking ties between geometrically identical entries.
This canonical ordering makes tied assignments reproducible under permutations of same-group submission identifiers.
The target-conditioned overlap evaluator floors each reference side length at ϵ = 0.01 \epsilon=0.01 m while preserving its center.
For each prediction–target pair it translates the candidate target’s box to the prediction, giving a score determined by the predicted center, candidate center, and candidate extent.
